name: Performance budget
summary: What a map or the largest Shard of any biome may cost (S53). tools/perf_budget.gd measures every template at its largest size and every handcrafted map against these; the unit test holds the counts and prints the times. logic_ms is the game's own per-frame work headless (no rendering); frame_ms is what a Deck-class target must hold with rendering, read from the --perf counter in a build.
